A company's [earnings report](https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/latest/) provides a comprehensive overview of its financial performance. [Insights from company executives](https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/transcripts/) on financial results, market trends, operational challenges, and growth strategies. When a company releases its earnings report, investors and analysts carefully scrutinize the results to assess whether it[met, exceeded, or fell short of market expectations](https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/beats-and-misses/). A lower-than-expected earning reports often lead to downward revisions in earnings forecasts, [decreased analyst target prices](https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/most-downgraded/), and selling pressure on the company's stock. On the flip side, when a company reports lower-than-expected earnings, the market typically[turns bearish](https://www.marketbeat.com/originals/are-these-frigid-dow-stocks-in-for-a-longer-winter/)as investors interpret the negative earnings surprise as a sign of underlying weaknesses, revenue declines, cost overruns or challenges in the company's business operations. *   [Oracle (6/10/2026)](https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NYSE/ORCL/earnings/). *   [Adobe (6/11/2026)](https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/ADBE/earnings/). *   [Accenture (6/18/2026)](https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NYSE/ACN/earnings/). *   [FedEx (6/23/2026)](https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NYSE/FDX/earnings/). *   [Micron Technology (6/24/2026)](https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/MU/earnings/). *   [NIKE (6/30/2026)](https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NYSE/NKE/earnings/). *   [Fastenal (7/13/2026)](https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/FAST/earnings/). *   [Bank of America (7/14/2026)](https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NYSE/BAC/earnings/).

# Oracle (ORCL) Earnings Date, Estimates & Call Transcripts. Oracle released Q3 2026 earnings on March 10, 2026, reporting an EPS of **$1.79**, which beat the consensus estimate of **$1.71** by  **$0.08**. With a trailing EPS of *$5.57* and a P/E Ratio of *38.31*, Oracle's earnings are expected to grow *3.95%* next year, from **$6.08** to **$6.32** per share. Oracle's Q4 2026 earnings is estimated for Wednesday, June 10, 2026, based on past reporting schedules, with a conference call scheduled at 5:00 PM ET. ## ORCL Earnings Estimates and Actuals by Quarter. ## ORCL Estimated and Actual Revenue by Quarter. ### What guidance has Oracle issued on next quarter's earnings? The company provided earnings per share (EPS) guidance of 1.960-2.000 for the period, compared to the consensus EPS estimate of 1.780.
